reviews.text:
Charged without consent. I download this app to try and deleted it without signing up.
I was charged $39.99 without my consent. I am letting my credit card company know. Don’t try!!!
Free trial isn’t true. I canceled next day and the following day but still a year subscription came out of my account. I have emailed again asking for my money back and no response.
It just does not work. It never sees a plant in my photos.

Will not identify. This app no longer identifies plants for me. It was working for a little while and I was able to ID probably 20 or so plants in travels as I was planning my own landscaping project. Now it says all of my pictures are out of focus and the app all the sudden stops working. I even tried to take a picture of one of my house plants in perfect lighting and still, says there is something wrong with my photo. This app is cool if it works, but I think mine no longer works so I will not renew.

Useless. I think AI created this App. Zero correct identification 6 months on, Zero updates. ‘Advice’ is beyond generic, it’s just a link to the wrong wikis 😂… seriously it’s a scam App. Apple shouldn’t allow remove and reimburse…
Vegetables. Does not recognize vegetable sprouts
Gore. Horrible app. Can’t cancel. Used it 2 times it did not tell me how to fix the plant. I want to cancel and can not
I’m starting to like it. Diagnosing my plants
Perfect for me. I just bought the app and see it will answer sooooo many questions for me!! I will be getting the lifetime account. Yay!!

Good start, but …. I started using this app about nine months ago. It did a good job at first of identifying plants. More recently it started misidentifying plants egregiously and most recently cannot detect any photo that I take. And I paid for this. From other reviews, this is clearly not a good site. Going to something better. Would give no stars if I could.

Plant app. This was worthless to me. It basically said all my plants were unhealthy and gave the same diagnosis for all of the 5 different plants I checked. These plants were in different locations and not the same kind. Not even continuing with the free trial!
Cancellation. Please cancel trial subscription .
Love this app. I like how it identifies plants for forage in home use
Review. This app tells me the same thing is wrong with every plant.
No expert. Very disappointed. I asked a question and she said sorry I’m not here to answer questions. I want my money back.

Scam. I feel like this might be a scam since I purchased a year membership and now I can’t even access the dang thing…. I tried using the “contact us” tab and it refuses to send a message. Very disappointing.

SCAM SCAM SCAM!!!. Do not even consider trying this app out unless you want to be scammed!! 

They offered a trial period and I didn’t think to much about that because I only needed to ID one plant. Then I never touched that app again. All of a sudden it randomly changed my account $40 without my approval. 

They probably have something written in fine print but that’s how they get away with these scams.

Great app. The only problem I have is a free trial keeps popping up and I can’t use the app. Otherwise I would give it 5 star. The few times I was able to capture an image and identify the plant, it was fantastic.
Can’t analyze images. Says the data is not in the correct format and doesn’t tell me how to fix it.
It’s not working. Wasted money do not purchase this app.

This app is pretty cool. The app identified a different name every time I took a picture of the same plant, is not really accurate but is still cool learning facts about the plant even though it might not be YOUR plant your learning about…. well, it might just be some plants look a lot alike so it might be more accurate with another type of flower/ plant picture than mine specifically but IDK…

Gets it wrong…a LOT!. I just bought an alocasia stingray plant which was labelled as such when I bought it-it has very obvious “sting-ray” looking leaves & was excited to use this app just to know its accuracy…it never got it right! I took multiple photos & ea time it identified as something different-ugh!
This happened w several other plants that I knew-very disappointed as sometimes someone will give me a plant & I need to know what it’s needs are so it can thrive in the right environment. Will be cancelling my free 3-day trial
WhatPlant is easy to use and very accurate. This app is very easy to use. I finally know the names to all of my plants!
Does not work.. I be tried multiple views but on multiple plants and did not identify any.

not accurate, too expensive, too many ads. it didn't work in identifying a group of plants. it is choked with too many distracting ads and continuous push to purchase annual subscription. more annoying than informative ...
Happy me. It’s addictive, can’t stop identifying all the plants in my home, backyard, and surrounding area.

No Longer Working. Purchased this app a year ago. 
Whenever I take a photo of a plant I get a message saying the plant can’t be found.
Can’t get any help so looks like I wasted quite a lot of money
Stopped working!!. I payed for the whole year and the app is not working!!!!!!!!!!!!!

SO QUICK-SO EASY!!!. I’m not a newcomer to gardening and all its wonderful heartwarming pleasures, both in
the planning, the choosing, the design and above all the time spent with my husband over the years. Sadly I lost my gardening
other half nearly four years ago and though my heart is willing and wanting to continue my poor green thumb as was is now a more normal shade of pink as I have simply run out of the energy it needs to maintain two gardens that we both ‘pioneered’ together on. But I’ve been so lucky in finding a team of lovely gardening ladies who have the energy, strength and willpower I once may have had and I’ve even met them at my door on more than one occasion in pouring rain in their wet gear and Debo happily did their two hours without one single word of complaint I feel so blessed to have found these lovely girls. So my job now is helping one of my two daughters, who has two beautiful gardens, gain her green thumb award and she is doing very well. I’m trying to persuade her to try to keep a record of new plants she adds to her garden and with the help of your great app I think we may be on the way. Thanku for such a brilliant idea, I wish you’d been around when we first started in earnest with our gardens over the years - and we’ve had a few! 
 PS Our other daughter owns and runs an English Lavender Farm in USA - she discovered she had a green thumb quite early on !! ….. enough said I think!!!

Great app. It’s been fascinating finding out what common weeds actually are: so many ‘weeds’ in the garden and outside in the countryside turn out to be edible or have historical medicinal uses. It is, and continues to be, a revelation to me. The app is very easy to use: just click the camera and the other information comes up. I wasn’t sure how much I’d use it but it’s great on walks out and in the garden so we’ll worth the money.
Not the best. The app took the full payment before the 3 days trial was over leaving me out of pocket as the app got the plant wrong twice

Very poor. Photographed well known vegetable- gave me 4 different answers none of which were correct.
Not impressed!

Absolute rubbish. Tried to take photos of 3/4 different plants at so many different angles and distances. The only response was try again. So annoyed at myself for downloading this app. I don't recall I've left a review on an app before but this really took the biscuit.

a waste of space. This app is not up to what it promises, in fact it is useless.
I wanted something to bring names of plants back to me.At 82 I often can’t remember the name of a plant, this app is no help as it cannot identify most of my plants in the first place.
Great app. Very useful for new gardeners

Fantastic! Super impressed it picked up on off the wall tropical species. Really impressed with this. I moved down to Costa Rica 6 years ago and it can be difficult to get a proper ID on plants and trees here. Out of 20 id’s it failed only on one but it got me super close to where I could narrow it down. This is, imo, 100% worth a purchase. Most plant id apps are horrible this is the exact opposite!
Scam. Your lifetime subscription will stop working after less than 1 year & and you’ll get zero support.
Don’t get. It makes you pay eventually

Wow.. pretty good. Okay I’ll be honest I can’t afford to pay $50 to unlock the full app, but there is the option of watching a 15-30 second video (witch I hope the creator gets paid that way) this app has helped me to identify at least 50 berries, leafy greens, mushrooms and nuts!!! As a vegan and someone that is newer to foraging this app has been great!! With links to Wikipedia and Google you can find out all the information about the plant you want. I am very glad to have found this app. Thank you

Not useful. I have uploaded 4 or 5 pictures of MUSHROOMS and the app keeps identifying the small plants UNDER and BEHIND the mushrooms! 

I started this AND payed for it to help identify mushrooms and it plainly does not work
This is not a free app. Do not get this app you can’t even use it on the free trial till you pay. Total scam Do not download
